content.short: Cardano Play 2 Earn NFT Autobattler, inspired by Teamfight Tactics, featuring some of the best parts of Axie Infinity.
content.description:
This game is a competitive PvP game being developed with the Fun First philosophy, with a feature set comparable to today's most popular non-crypto autobattlers. ZiberBugs is an initiative started due to the extreme lack of gameplay quality in NFT games. It strives to provide great entertainment, made by a team with over 30,000 joint hours in competitive gaming. The game is in early development, but upon release, it will feature the following:

Future developments and efforts will be made towards eSports and streaming, upgrading the game engine, expanding on the Ziberverse by creating additional games, implementing Land ownership that features base construction, adventure mode and more.
